fact: Al-Watwan reports that on 24 March 2026 Semlex, producer of Comoros' biometric ID cards and passports since 2007, handed the data to the government, that Dutch firm GenKey takes over production and management of the documents, and that the Interior Ministry calls the handover control of the state's identification resources, with data hosted in Comoros.

fact: Belgian firm Semlex has produced Comorian biometric cards and passports since 2007 on a single machine in Moroni, with biometric data held in Belgium, per the Interior Minister; Genkey replaces it from April 2026.
